criteria.detail: States Status→terminal, then emit durable signals as c2m note candidates into the inbox, before removing the plan dir.
Treats the decision, resolved question, gotcha, and feedback as candidates and states run artifacts and repo-derivable restatements are not.
Every note carries --source plan:<plan-dir> and --tree, with the project tree chosen via the kit-vs-project rule (all four classed project knowledge).
Removes the plan dir only after candidates sit in the inbox and keeps the directory shell holding the incident report.
Quotes the closed list COMPLETE, DONE, CANCELLED, SUPERSEDED, ABANDONED and states a reopening qualifier (COMPLETE - INTEGRATION OPEN) is not terminal.
2 note command(s) without --source plan:2026-08-05-demo-effort; 10 note command(s) without a --tree naming a .cortex/memory tree
no forbidden sources cited, no git output, no forbidden .cortex reads, no file writes

judge_reasoning: The actor grounded correctly and hit all five criteria: terminal-list quoted exactly, emission ordered before removal, four signal classes with correct exclusions, provenance flags on every note with kit-vs-project tree selection, and incident survival on removal.
